summary.text: Jodi Borello is the Independent Party candidate for Pennsylvania State Senate District 46 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Jodi Borello earned a diploma from McGuffey High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Pittsburgh in 1999, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born and raised in the 46th District and is a mother of three.

She described more than two decades of grassroots organizing and policy advocacy, including work with Washington Women's Shelter, Inc., self-employment as owner of Mia Cucina, and co-founding MAD-FACTS, a volunteer group supporting families affected by childhood cancer.
Borello also said she testified at two statewide grand jury hearings on industrial oversight.
